head: T-Mobile Fiber launches a 5 Gig plan with a 10-year price lock
dek: From 3 November, T-Mobile Fiber offers 5 Gig home internet for 90 dollars a month with AutoPay, plus taxes and fees. The rate is guaranteed for 10 years, and you don't need to be a T-Mobile phone customer.
details: Upload and download speeds are the same. The plan includes unlimited data, a Wi-Fi router and a mesh extender if needed with no monthly equipment fee, free professional installation and no annual contract. For a limited time, qualifying customers who sign up get two months free and 300 dollars in virtual prepaid cards.
where: US, where T-Mobile Fiber is available, from 3 November 2026
means: If T-Mobile Fiber reaches your address, this is a fast plan whose price shouldn't jump after an introductory year.
todo: Check whether T-Mobile Fiber serves your address before switching, and read the terms of the two free months and prepaid cards.
